summary: Iteration 9: Node.js Express backend (port 3002) fully tested. All 12 pytest tests pass (100%). Frontend homepage and admin dashboard verified working.
verified_working: POST /api/auth/login with hello@sojaru.co.in / admin123 returns JWT with is_admin: true
GET /api/settings returns hero, marquee_texts, festive, category_images fields
GET /api/products returns {items, total, pages} with total > 0
POST /api/admin/hero-images uploads to Cloudinary, returns hero_images array with Cloudinary URL
Customizable products CRUD: POST → GET → PUT → DELETE all pass
vercel.json is valid JSON with framework, buildCommand, outputDirectory, rewrites keys
Frontend homepage loads (title: Sojaru — Bohemian Lifestyle Brand, marquee visible)
Admin /admin page loads with email+password login form
critical_code_review_comments: vercel.json has framework: null (not a string like 'create-react-app') — this is intentional for custom build but worth confirming Vercel accepts null for framework field
api/index.js local standalone mode defaults to PORT 3001 but review request expects 3002 — supervisor likely sets PORT=3002 env var
context_for_next_testing_agent: Node.js backend fully migrated from FastAPI. api/index.js running on port 3002 via supervisor (PORT=3002 env). All routes functional. vercel.json uses framework:null + buildCommand + outputDirectory + rewrites pattern for Vercel serverless. Python backend still on 8001 for preview env only.
